notes: Every measurement in Settings and the scan panel now comes from the design system. 347 padding, margin, spacing and text-size values were written as fixed pixels that no theme could reach; they are all bound to the shared scale now, so the…

Nothing looks different on the default theme. The change was checked by comparing every measurement of every element on both screens before and after — 4,771 values on one, 2,093 on the other, with no difference at all.
The build now refuses any new fixed measurement in those screens, so this cannot creep back one value at a time.
